title: Aetherium Convergence
description: Master the convergence of technology and magic in a vast world built for boundless creativity. Conquer immense dungeons and mythic beasts with steam-powered machinery and arcane spells.
body:
### ✨ Main Features

## ⚙️ Engineering & Industry
- **Create & Expansions**: Steam Rails, Deco, New Age, Big Cannons, Conveyors  
- Build fully automated factories powered by gears, shafts, and belts  
- Design mechanical quarries, automated farms, and transport systems  
- Wield industrial-scale weapons like **cannons and siege engines**  
- Every machine feels alive—powered by motion, not magic

## 🔮 Magic & RPG Progression
- **Wizards, Spell Engine, Runes, Elemental Wizards RPG** for limitless spellcraft  
- Master **diverse classes** like Paladin, Archer, or Battlemage  
- Unlock new abilities through progression and gear synergy  
- **Better Combat** redefines fighting with fluid swings, parries, and combos  
- **Simply Swords & DragonLoot** add mythical weapons and rare treasures  
- Every battle feels like a tactical dance rather than button mashing

## 🌍 Exploration & Adventure
- **Terrain overhauls**: Terralith, Biomes O’ Plenty, Regions Unexplored, Nature’s Spirit  
- Discover landscapes of towering peaks, lush valleys, and strange new forests  
- **Extra dimensions**: BetterEnd, BetterNether, Deeper & Darker, Nullscape  
- New worlds bring unique blocks, mobs, and challenges  
- **Dungeon expansions**: YUNG’s Structures, Dungeons & Taverns, Medieval Buildings  
- Explore massive ruins, labyrinthine strongholds, and dangerous temples  
- Face **multi-stage bosses** and world events that keep the world unpredictable

## 🛡️ Gear, Crafting & Building
- **Mythic Metals, Alloy Forgery, Many More Ores & Crafts** expand the resource pool  
- Forge legendary weapons, armor sets, and enchanted artifacts  
- Tame mounts, build vehicles, and equip gear with unique bonuses  
- **Building mods**: Macaw’s suite, Handcrafted, Supplementaries, Fairylights  
- Decorate castles, fortresses, villages, and sprawling industrial complexes  
- Blend medieval architecture with modern or steampunk styles

## 🚀 Space Exploration
- **Ad Astra** takes survival beyond the overworld  
- Build rockets and space stations to expand your empire  
- Explore moons and alien planets filled with strange biomes  
- Gather exotic ores and rare resources found nowhere on Earth  
- Establish **colonies** in space and survive hostile extraterrestrial environments  

## ⚡ Performance & Quality of Life
- Optimized with **Sodium, Lithium, Starlight, ModernFix** for smoother gameplay  
- Faster world loading, reduced lag, and stable performance  
- **Utility mods**: Xaero’s Minimap, REI, AppleSkin, Inventory Profiles Next  
- Better inventory management, recipe viewing, and survival info  
- Accessibility improvements so the pack runs well without sacrificing depth  

---

## 🎮 What Awaits You
A seamless blend of **magic, machinery, survival, and exploration**, powered by **200+ mods**.  
- Build sprawling factories and kinetic cities  
- Master ancient spellcraft and become a legendary mage  
- Conquer massive dungeons, strongholds, and bosses  
- Launch into the stars and carve your destiny among alien worlds
